name: Raising On Purpose - Pinterest via Buffer (2x daily)

parameters.content:
## Pinterest x Buffer setup (do once)
1. Buffer access token: Buffer > avatar > Apps & Extras > Developers > create Publish API token > replace YOUR_BUFFER_ACCESS_TOKEN (2 places).
2. Pinterest must be connected in Buffer (Publishing > Channels). The workflow auto-finds it.
3. Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID_HERE (Read Sheet + Mark Pinned).
4. Add 2 columns to the sheet: `Pinned` and `Pinned At` (anywhere, exact headers).
5. Schedule runs 9:00 + 15:00 SERVER time. Railway defaults to UTC: set env N8N_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE (e.g. America/New_York) or shift the cron hours.
6. One run = one pin (oldest Done + unpinned row). Empty queue = run ends silently.
